mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, conversation_id, status, goal_draft_json, last_question_field, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM GOAL_INTERVIEW_SESSIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT goal_id, session_id, user_id, conversation_id, title, goal_type, target_amount, target_date, motivation, priority, initial_amount, required_monthly_amount, status, created_at, updated_at FROM FINANCIAL_GOALS WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, goal_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT goal_id, session_id, user_id, conversation_id, title, goal_type, target_amount, target_date, motivation, priority, initial_amount, required_monthly_amount, status, created_at, updated_at FROM FINANCIAL_GOALS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY goal_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GOAL_INTERVIEW_SESSIONS ( user_id, conversation_id, status, goal_draft_json, last_question_field ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{status}, #{goalDraftJson}, #{lastQuestionField} )
mapper.update: UPDATE GOAL_INTERVIEW_SESSIONS SET goal_draft_json = #{goalDraftJson}, last_question_field = #{lastQuestionField}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE GOAL_INTERVIEW_SESSIONS SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FINANCIAL_GOALS ( session_id, user_id, conversation_id, title, goal_type, target_amount, target_date, motivation, priority, initial_amount, required_monthly_amount, status ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{title}, #{goalType}, #{targetAmount}, #{targetDate}, #{motivation}, #{priority}, #{initialAmount}, #{requiredMonthlyAmount}, #{status} )
